error.message: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the Converse operation: User: assumed-role BeaconpaveGateway-HighlightsAgentRole401A2F1B-n2IM1FZYwsLI is not authorized to perform: bedrock:InvokeModel on resource: inference-profile us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 with an explicit deny in an identity-based policy

_note: Claim 4's runtime artifact, recorded as-run. The role is the governed service execution role, the same one the agent holds from M02. ARNs are reduced to resource names: this repo is public and an account-qualified ARN is refused even when the account is redacted. The phrase that matters is 'with an explicit deny in an identity-based policy' — mere absence of a grant produces a vaguer message that does not distinguish forbidden from overlooked.
